reviews.title: Strait of Hormuz aviation GNSS quality anomaly
reviews.reason: The GPSInterference.com source provides an ADS-B-derived estimate of the GNSS quality anomaly in the Strait of Hormuz. While the robust Z score of 0.48 indicates a moderate anomaly, the sample size of 38 and median change of -0.75 suggest a low confidence in the anomaly. The lack of corroboration and official alert further reduce the confidence. The anomaly is not evidence of an exceptional strategic anomaly and should be monitored closely.
